title: Advances in surface-enhanced Raman scattering applications for precision agriculture: monitoring plant health and crop quality
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,49320-49352
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08452K, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ha Anh Nguyen, Dao Thi Nguyet Nga, To Dao Cuong, Mai Quan Doan, Anh-Tuan Le
This review surveys surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS) for plant health and crop quality, relating plasmonic substrate design, sampling strategies and data analysis to sensitive, selective detection of plant stress markers and residues.
